attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Changes core caching/shape-metadata semantics (Cache() keyed by shape Type, new cache-context stack, removed debug wrapper shape) affecting DynamicCache and ShapeMetadata used across all themes/modules, so any downstream module relying on the old Cache()/CachedShapeWrapper behavior or on cache scope tracking by CacheId could silently misbehave despite extensive new tests."}

reason: Changes core caching/shape-metadata semantics (Cache() keyed by shape Type, new cache-context stack, removed debug wrapper shape) affecting DynamicCache and ShapeMetadata used across all themes/modules, so any downstream module relying on the old Cache()/CachedShapeWrapper behavior or on cache scope tracking by CacheId could silently misbehave despite extensive new tests.
